title: Christ Above Every Power
definition: Christ Above Every Power refers to the biblical truth about the unseen spiritual realm.
summary: Christ Above Every Power refers to the biblical truth about the unseen spiritual realm.
christFocus: Christ reigns over every visible and invisible power.

studySections.heading: Doctrine in Summary
studySections.content:
Christ Above Every Power recognizes spiritual reality while keeping God, not the spiritual realm, at the center. All spiritual realities remain created, limited, and under god’s rule.

Scripture speaks soberly about angels, demons, Satan, and unseen conflict, but it refuses fear, obsession, and speculation. People need truth without fear, denial, or obsession.

Christ is supreme over every spiritual being and power. Christ reigns over every visible and invisible power. Believers stand in His victory through Scripture, prayer, faith, and the power of the Holy Spirit.

studySections.heading: Why This Matters
studySections.content:
Spiritual reality affects real life, but Scripture keeps the believer from fear and fascination. People need truth without fear, denial, or obsession. The unseen realm must be understood under the rule of God and the victory of Christ.

It also protects against spiritual confusion. Angels are servants, demons are defeated enemies, Satan is limited, and Christ alone is worthy of trust and worship.

studySections.heading: Discipleship and Application
studySections.content: Keep the spiritual realm under the lordship of Christ in your thinking. Bring this doctrine into prayer, Scripture, and daily obedience. Ask the Holy Spirit to make the truth real in your thinking, desires, relationships, and next faithful step with Christ.
